summary: Evaluate (Alg 3) throws std::overflow_error('integer length overflow') on a valid uint64 hierarchy from Algorithm 4 whose distances all fit: one edge of length 2^63. Suspected cause: the Sec 4.1 mass S(C) = h(C) + link lengths (+ S of internal children) = 2^64, or the expiry D0 + S(X) of Alg 3 l.9; these are bookkeeping bounds, not distances. At the paper's size the same failure appears on lt::clustered(209953, 107) (MST total about 2^70).

found_by.test: differential:Alg 4 Mode A + Evaluate at k = 209953: clustered, heavy uint64 bridges

expected: the exact distances; the mass S(C), the expiry D0 + S(C) and the slot ends saturate at the infinity sentinel (D-13 extended to Sec 4, candidate D-23)
